```artifact
Feature: User Experience
  As a user with no computer background
  I want to be able to use the system relatively easily
  So that I can complete my tasks efficiently

  Scenario: Simple Navigation
    Given the user is on the home page
    When the user clicks on the "Consultation Request" tab
    Then the user is taken to the consultation request form

  Scenario: Filling Out a Consultation Request
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When the user fills out the form with minimal and only relevant questions
    Then the form is submitted in less than 5 minutes

  Scenario: Installation Guide
    Given the user is on the home page
    When the user clicks on the "Installation Guide" link
    Then the user is taken to the installation guide page

  Scenario: User Manual
    Given the user is on the home page
    When the user clicks on the "User Manual" link
    Then the user is taken to the user manual page

  Scenario Outline: Error Handling
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When the user enters invalid data
    Then the system displays an error message
    Examples:
      | error message |
      | Invalid input |
      | Missing field  |
      | Invalid format |

  Scenario Outline: Boundary Values
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When the user fills out the form with the following questions:
      | question | answer |
      | 1        | yes   |
      | 2        | no    |
      | 3        | yes   |
    Then the form is submitted in less than 5 minutes
    Examples:
      | question | answer |
      | 1        | yes   |
      | 2        | no    |
      | 3        | yes   |
      | 4        | yes   |
      | 5        | no    |

  Scenario Outline: Edge Cases
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When the user fills out the form with the following questions:
      | question | answer |
      | 1        | yes   |
      | 2        | no    |
      | 3        | yes   |
      | 4        | no    |
      | 5        | yes   |
    Then the form is submitted in less than 5 minutes
    Examples:
      | question | answer |
      | 1        | yes   |
      | 2        | no    |
      | 3        | yes   |
      | 4        | no    |
      | 5        | yes   |
      | 6        | no    |
      | 7        | yes   |
      | 8        | no    |
      | 9        | yes   |
      | 10       | no    |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid Input
    Given the user is on the consultation request form
    When the user enters the following invalid input:
      | input | value |
      | name  | abc   |
      | email | xyz   |
    Then the system displays an error message
    Examples:
      | input | value |
      | name  | abc   |
      | email | xyz   |
      | phone | 123   |
      | address | 456   |
```
